protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: transformDecls passes every declaration value through remToPx before the scalable px branch. The pre-fix /(\d*\.?\d+)rem/g catastrophically backtracks on a long digit run not followed by rem; an independently bounded run on 5,000 zeros plus p exceeded 5 seconds, while the fixed expression processed 100,000 zeros plus p in about 1 ms. The fix also adds the corresponding 100k-zero regression test.
